sub_indicators.label: AI harms
sub_indicators.subject: tech.ai
sub_indicators.text: Control of AI abuse: AI harms
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Continental AI Strategy asks for risk-based regulation, an independent oversight body with enforcement and redress, technical safety standards and a part in regional oversight.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no authority, rule or mechanism addresses harms from AI.
A bill, draft regulation or draft guideline addressing a harm from AI is published, or a draft provides for an authority over AI.
A law, decree, regulation or binding directive in force addresses a harm from AI, such as deepfakes, automated decisions or AI in elections.
A body is designated by law or decree with a mandate over AI harms or AI systems.
A dated enforcement, audit, takedown, penalty or redress decision about a harm from AI is on record.
